column1: Module 1: Authentication & Access Control (US-01 to US-06)

column2: User Story
column3: Expected Deliverable / Output
column5: Comment

column2: As a cashier, I want to sign in with username + password so I can open the POS terminal.
column3: Session issued with role=cashier; redirect to /cashier/terminal; failed attempts return validation error.

column2: As an owner, I want to authenticate with username + password + 4-digit PIN so executive controls stay secure.
column3: /admin/dashboard accessible only after all three factors pass; session carries role=owner.

column2: As an owner, I want a valid password + wrong PIN rejected so staff can't reach managerial screens.
column3: Inline error banner "Invalid Owner PIN"; no session created; attempt logged.

column2: As an owner, I want cashiers blocked from /admin/* so they can't change prices or see metrics.
column3: HTTP 403 or redirect to POS; EnsureUserIsOwner middleware on every admin route.

column2: As an authenticated user, I want to log out so the next operator can't inherit my session.
column3: Session flushed, cookies invalidated, redirect to login.

column2: As an owner, I want to create/update/deactivate cashier accounts so only active employees get POS access.
column3: User CRUD table in admin portal; bcrypt-hashed passwords; deactivated users fail login.

column1: Module 2: POS Order Intake & Transaction Processing (US-07 to US-16)

column2: User Story
column3: Expected Deliverable / Output
column5: Comment

column2: As a cashier, I want to process a walk-in refill (Slim or Round) so walk-in sales are recorded fast.
column3: Transaction row written; caps/seals/wraps auto-deducted per recipe; receipt generated.

column2: As a cashier, I want to log delivery orders against a customer profile so dispatched jugs are traceable.
column3: Transaction flagged order_type=delivery with customer_id; delivery address shown on slip.

column2: As a cashier, I want to add both Slim and Round refills to one ticket so mixed orders bill together.
column3: Dynamic cart panel; line items with unit price, quantity, running total.

column2: As a cashier, I want to sell caps, seals, soap, or faucets without a refill so OTC retail is tracked.
column3: Non-refill transaction; stock decremented for retail SKUs only.
column5: MSME design: POS buttons streamlined to refills & new jugs; consumables tracked via recipes & owner inventory.

column2: As a cashier, I want to input cash tendered and see live change calculation so rush-hour mental math errors are avoided.
column3: Change = Tendered − Total displayed live; cash drawer log; quick-cash pills (Exact/₱50/₱100/₱500/₱1,000).

column2: As a cashier, I want delivery orders to be automatically charged to the customer's account so drivers can collect payment on delivery without the cashier handling cash upfront.
column3: Delivery transactions saved as payment_status=unpaid; amount added to customers.debt_balance; walk-in sales always require cash and can never accrue debt.

column2: As a cashier, I want a delivery order's account charge to appear on the customer ledger so receivables stay accurate.
column3: Ledger entry created per delivery; running balance shown on customer card; settlement logged separately.

column2: As a cashier, I want an order slip with subtotal + 12% VAT so customers get compliant receipts.
column3: Print stylesheet isolating receipt; station header, items, VAT, grand total.

column2: As a manager, I want checkout aborted when stock is insufficient so no partial DB state remains.
column3: DB transaction rolled back; UI alert names the exact SKU short by N units.

column2: As a cashier, I want a live list of today's completed transactions so I can reconcile cash at shift end.
column3: Summary table: order count, cash collected, credit issued, per-transaction detail.

column1: Module 3: Returnable Container Custody (US-17 to US-23)

column2: User Story
column3: Expected Deliverable / Output
column5: Comment

column2: As a cashier, I want to log Gallons Out and Empties In at checkout so container transfers are documented.
column3: Net custody delta written to container_custody_logs per delivery checkout.
column5: Repo removed custody counters. Either restore custody tables + Fig 4 deficit branch, or rewrite this story for the MSME edition (station owns no jugs).

column2: As a cashier, I want separate custody balances per container shape so mismatches are prevented.
column3: Two balance fields: slim_jugs_pending, round_jugs_pending.
column5: Depends on US-17. If custody model is dropped, replace with "new jug retail stock per shape" tracking.

column2: As a cashier, I want zero liability when empties = dispatched so the account stays balanced.
column3: Custody delta = 0 logged; customer record unchanged; receipt notes "Balanced".
column5: Only meaningful if custody is restored; otherwise obsolete.

column2: As a cashier, I want to log returned empties outside a refill order so pending balances update.
column3: Standalone return entry decrements pending balance; ledger row created.
column5: README explicitly says "Empty Containers Returned intake... gone." Restore or drop.

column2: As a cashier, I want to flag cracked jugs so unusable containers don't clear the customer's obligation incorrectly.
column3: Defective-container entry deducts depot usable stock; scrap reason logged.
column5: README says "damaged-bottle write-off... gone." Either restore scrap logging, or fold into general stock adjustment (US-30).

column2: As a cashier, I want to record partial/full debt payments so cash received clears receivables.
column3: debt_balance reduced; Debt Payment transaction row; receipt shows remaining balance.

column2: As an owner, I want a table of customers with high container deficits so drivers prioritize collections.
column3: Who to Visit First widget ranking customers by missing jugs and uncollected pesos.
column5: Custody ledger removed in repo. Restore the widget, or replace with "customers with outstanding debt balances" ranking.

column2: As staff, I want to see all queued walk-in + delivery orders so jugs are processed in arrival order.
column3: Queue table: Ticket #, customer, bottle count, container type, elapsed wait time.

column2: As staff, I want one-click advancement to the next stage so cashiers know when an order is ready.

column2: As a cashier, I want to mark an order fulfilled/delivered so the ticket clears from the board.

column2: User Story
column3: Expected Deliverable / Output

column2: As an owner, I want to log vendor deliveries so stock is credited on arrival.
column3: Restock form: supplier, lot #, qty added, new stock level; ledger entry.

column2: As an owner, I want to record physical-count discrepancies with a reason so inventory reflects shelf reality.
column3: Adjustment modal (damage/spoilage/shrinkage); audit log row with user + timestamp + reason.
column5: Stock adjustments and lead-time updates recalculate ROP/SS immediately.

column2: As an owner, I want vendor profiles (contact, catalog, baseline lead time) so procurement is centralized.

column2: As an owner, I want to edit per-supplier lead times so thresholds adapt to delivery delays.
column3: Editable lead-time field; saving triggers ROP/SS recalculation on dependent SKUs.

column2: As an owner, I want on-hand filled Slim/Round jugs shown so the station never runs out of ready stock.
column3: Summary cards: filled vs empty jugs by shape in depot storage.
column5: Depends on whether station owns jugs. If not, repurpose card to show "new jug retail stock per shape."

column1: Module 6: Data Aggregation & Preprocessing (US-34 to US-37)

column2: User Story
column3: Expected Deliverable / Output
column5: Comment

column2: As the backend, I want to aggregate POS transactions into daily counts so forecasting has clean input.
column3: SQL aggregation producing chronological [date, daily_gallons] array sent to Tier 3.

column2: As the analytics service, I want ≥30 consecutive days enforced before fitting so reliability is guaranteed.
column3: Guard returning "Insufficient history (have N days, need 30)" if unmet.
column5: ARIMA engine gracefully enforces minimum points and falls back with a friendly indicator.

column2: As the analytics engine, I want ADF run on raw series so non-stationarity is detected before fitting.
column3: ADF statistic + p-value logged; auto-differencing if p > 0.05.

column2: As the analytics engine, I want first/second-order differencing until stationary so ARIMA assumptions hold.
column3: Differenced series persisted; d-order selected and logged; ADF re-run to confirm.

column2: User Story
column3: Expected Deliverable / Output
column5: Comment

column3: Best-order selection logged (e.g., ARIMA(1,1,1)); AIC/BIC comparison table stored.

column2: As the analytics engine, I want a 7-day gallon-refill forecast so near-term volume is quantified.
column3: 7 numeric values written to demand_forecasts with timestamps.

column2: As an owner, I want to toggle Daily/Weekly/Monthly views so I can plan short- and long-range.
column3: Aggregated forecast outputs served per horizon; toggle persists in UI.
column5: Daily/Weekly/Monthly forecast view switcher with aggregated demand chart.

column2: As an owner, I want MAPE/MAE/RMSE shown so I know the model's reliability.
column3: Confidence badge (e.g., "MAPE: 7.9% — High Confidence"); metrics table.
column5: MAPE, MAE, RMSE, AIC, and Ljung-Box diagnostic metrics calculated and stored.

column2: As the analytics engine, I want consumable depletion projected from forecasted refills so supply needs are clear.
column3: 7-day projected caps/seals/wraps/filter requirement array from refill forecast × recipe.

column1: Module 8: Dynamic Inventory Optimization (US-43 to US-47)

column2: User Story
column3: Expected Deliverable / Output
column5: Comment

column2: As an owner, I want SS computed from forecast variability × lead time so buffers adapt to demand.
column3: SS = Z × σ_leadtime × priority_factor per SKU (use cumulative forecast-error variance).

column2: As an owner, I want ROP = (Forecast Daily Demand × Lead Time) + SS so thresholds reflect real conditions.
column3: inventory_items.reorder_point updated after every forecast run.

column2: As an owner, I want below-ROP items flagged immediately so low stock is visible at a glance.
column3: Color-coded badges (Warning at ROP, Critical below SS) on dashboard.
column5: Color-coded stock pills and severity-ranked advisory system active on dashboard and inventory.

column2: As an owner, I want directives saying what to buy, how much, and from whom so ordering needs no math.
column3: Advisory card, e.g. "Order 800 Non-Spill Caps from EastPack now; 2.0 days of buffer left."

column2: As an admin, I want a nightly artisan command to refresh forecasts so dashboards are updated daily.
column3: Scheduled aquaflow:forecast at 02:00.
column5: Command aquaflow:forecast scheduled daily at 02:00.

column2: User Story
column3: Expected Deliverable / Output
column5: Comment

column3: Top-row responsive cards: daily revenue (₱), 7-day forecast gallons, active alert count, total pending jugs.

column2: As an owner, I want past 30 days plotted against the 7-day ARIMA projection so patterns are easy to read.
column3: Interactive chart: solid bars = history, dashed line = forecast; model label + MAPE.
column5: Interactive dual-dataset Chart.js visualization rendered on Dashboard & ARIMA tabs.

column1: Module 5 Addendum: Consumable Consumption Rules (US-51 to US-58)

column2: User Story
column3: Expected Deliverable / Output
column5: Comment

column2: As the system, I want to deduct 3 slim shrink wraps automatically when a slim refill is sold so wrap inventory reflects actual usage.
column3: Each Slim refill line decrements SHRINK_SLIM by 3 × qty; movement logged (type sale).
column5: Add product_consumables recipe row for Slim refill → 3× SHRINK_SLIM.

column2: As the system, I want to deduct 1 round shrink wrap automatically when a round refill is sold so wrap inventory reflects actual usage.
column3: Each Round refill line decrements SHRINK_ROUND by 1 × qty; movement logged.
column5: Add recipe row Round refill → 1× SHRINK_ROUND.

column2: As the system, I want to deduct 1 clear plastic cover for every jug dispatched (slim or round) so cover stock stays accurate.
column3: Every refill or new-jug sale decrements CLEAR_COVER by 1 × qty; movement logged.
column5: Add recipe rows for all 4 SKUs → 1× CLEAR_COVER.

column2: As the system, I want new Slim and Round jug sales to consume the same shrink wraps as refills (3 for Slim, 1 for Round) so a jug leaving the station is fully accounted for.
column3: New Slim jug deducts 3 SHRINK_SLIM; New Round jug deducts 1 SHRINK_ROUND; both deduct 1 CLEAR_COVER.
column5: Confirm with owner whether new-jug sales consume wraps. If yes, add recipe rows.

column2: As an owner, I want each product to declare how many of each consumable it consumes per sale so rules are configurable, not hardcoded.
column3: product_consumables table linking product_id → inventory_item_id → qty_per_sale; editable in admin.
column5: Replace 1-to-1 products.inventory_item_id with a recipe table (1-to-many).

column2: As a cashier, I want a mixed cart (e.g., 2 Slim + 1 Round) to deduct the correct total wraps and covers so bulk orders don't skew inventory.
column3: Total deduction = sum across all line items × recipe qty; verified by feature test.
column5: Feature test: 2 Slim + 1 Round → 6 slim wraps + 1 round wrap + 3 covers.

column2: As a station manager, I want checkout to abort if any required wrap or cover is out of stock so no partial sale is recorded.
column3: DB transaction rolled back; UI alert names the missing consumable and exact shortfall.
column5: Extend existing US-15 rollback guard to iterate over all recipe items.

column2: As an owner, I want every consumable deduction logged against a transaction so I can trace where stock went.
column3: stock_movements row per deduction (type sale, qty negative, linked transaction_id).
column5: Add stock_movements table with transaction_id FK.
